title: Avor Kel
text:
# Avor Kel

## Overview

He and Sera later get married, only for Sera to reveal herself as a Vhalan Compact agent out to kill Avor Kel, arrest Veyran, and all of his associates. Despite being shot multiple times, Avor Kel is soon resurrected by the Compact as the cyborg Avor Ember in order to serve them. In "Star Talen: Veyranreturn of the Daren", Avor Ember - under the control of the Vhalan Compact - comes face to face with Veyran, and fights him, almost killing him, before being shut down by Selra Aster.

Following the destruction of the Compact, Avor Ember was salvaged by the Voss household and resided in Veyran's garage lab, until Veyran restored him to normal. Avor Kel then discovered he had a daughter with Sera and went to search for her.

## Biography

title: Avor Kel
text:
## Biography

Veyran-N-482 and Memory Veyran eavesdrop on a meeting between Dawn Vanguard fighters where a Vhaloran says, "Some of us still have home planets to protect," to which Avor Kel responds, "And some of us do not. We need to fight. The impassive is incapable of mercy." Altogether, this seems to imply that Avor Kel's home planet was destroyed by the Compact (likely via the infection shown that causes glowing red eyes and a loss of reason in Kelari), which is why he joined the Dawn Wardens.

He is also one of the very few party-goers who remains behind to help clean up, although he may have just been waiting for Sera to be ready to leave.

When Talen shows his frustration at the party's mess as it would mean no more adventures with Veyran if his parents see the house in this state, Avor Kel informs Talen that "Nava Kora Ven" means "I am in great pain, please help me" in his native language. Talen is skeptical that Veyran actually means this, though this knowledge spurs him to eventually press Veyran into action to preserve their ability to go on adventures together.

title: Avor Kel
text:
He explains to Talen that leaving Veyran was a "dick move", and that Veyran really does care about him. Furthermore, if it wasn't for Veyran, he [Avor Kel] would be dead and would never have met Talen. He then recharges the Rift Spindle and sends Talen back to Veyran.

In "Videlu Safalo," it can be noted that Avor Kel and Veyran have been acquainted for years, as there are many picture frames containing Veyran on his wall. During Avor Kel's early adulthood, he, Veyran and Zorvik formed a band called "Sefane Losemi", where Avor Kel was featured as the main singer. Avor Kel can also be seen beside a younger Veyran, and some sort of aircraft.

In "Loneri Deriri", he and Sera get married and have a huge wedding party. During this time, he confessed to Selra that he and Veyran are wanted by the Vhalan Compact for committing "crimes in the name of freedom" which Selra shrugs off. Shortly after, during the reception, Sera reveals herself to be a member of the Vhalan Compact's secret service and shoots Avor Kel multiple times, followed by a shootout with the rest of the criminals in the room.

## Avor Ember

Sera and the Yavari resurrected Avor Kel as a cyborg and renamed him Avor Ember. Although Sera wanted his name to be Avor Alloy, she didn't push hard enough to make that official. She settled on Avor Ember and took off with him.

title: Avor Kel
text: In "Faneko Viteri", Veyran came face to face with Avor Ember where they briefly talked and started fighting as soon as Veyran said that he killed Sera. Avor Ember flew into a rage and fought Veyran to death. During their fight, Veyran mentioned how he wondered who would win in a fight between them, to which Avor Ember replied that Veyran was "always a bad friend." The fight seemed to gain in favor of Avor Ember, as Veyran was suffering from massive injuries to the point where his cyber-augmented intestines spilled out. Just before Veyran was about to accept his death, the fight was interrupted by both Selra and her counterpart Selra Aster. However, Avor Ember ended the fight quickly. Just before he could kill Veyran, Daren (equipped with the invisible belt) used Sera's corpse to pretend that she was still alive. Avor Ember was surprised but was suspicious by how she was acting. Daren then tripped on top of the corpse, accidentally uncloaking himself.

title: Bounded Horizon
text:
# Bounded Horizon

## Overview

The Bounded Horizon was designed by the precursors of what would later become the Assembly of Veyrans on Concord Spire and Veyran Kest N-482 to wall off the infinite number of universes in which Veyran is the smartest person alive from the rest of the infinite Ridete Desevi.

The Bounded Horizon is a wall built around infinity, separating all the infinite universes from all the infinite universes where Veyrans are the smartest being in the universe, essentially meaning outside the confines of the Bounded Horizon, there are a lot more beings that could potentially be smarter than some of the smartest Veyrans in the entire Ridete Desevi. Doing so ended up with his portal turning a sleek gold instead of slime green like all the others.

## Known Dimensions within/close to curve

N-731 is also the dimension from which the current Selra and Neris originated from.

## Formation

title: Bounded Horizon
text:
## Known Dimensions within/close to curve

N-731 is also the dimension from which the current Selra and Neris originated from.

## Formation

In the wake of losing his wife and daughter to a bombing by Veyran Oris, N-482 became consumed with finding his evil doppelgänger and eventually succeeded in creating his first Rift Spindle, allowing him access to the infinite Ridete Desevi and all the worlds beyond. For years, N-482 rampaged across the Ridete Desevi killing every other Veyran he could find but never finding the one he sought. In doing so, he also took the opportunity to expand his intellect along the way by scanning and absorbing vast amounts of knowledge from numerous alien worlds into his brain until he became one of the smartest and most dominant beings in all of existence but not the smartest overall.

title: Bounded Horizon
text: Finally, after decades of hunting and killing, N-482 could take no more and signed a peace-treaty with a congregation of his counterparts, part of which involved the construction of a massive, hyper-metropolis space-station called Concord Spire to serve as a home for all the Veyrans and Talens in the Ridete Desevi. Unbeknownst to the Talens however, N-482 and the fledgling Assembly of Veyrans took things a step further by creating what became known as "The Bounded Horizon". Using an advanced variation of their Rift Spindle technology, they built a massive machine underneath Concord Spire designed to lock out travel to or from any universe, within the Ridete Desevi, in which Veyran himself was not the dominant lifeform or the smartest being alive, for example, universes where Daren is the smartest being in the universe, or universes where Veyran Kest doesn't exist. This lockout ensured that all Veyrans and Talens could only travel to universes within the Bounded Horizon, universes where Veyran was always guaranteed to be the most dominant and the smartest being alive.

title: Bounded Horizon
text:
In essence, the Veyrans separated out every universe in which Veyran wasn't on top of the food chain and isolated themselves and the Talens within that collection of universes from the rest of the Ridete Desevi at large, thereby perpetuating the myth among the Talens, their families and all the alien races they encountered that Veyran was truly top of the food chain. It is assumed Veyran Kest N-482 himself did this to lock up Veyran Oris, in which case he failed. Eventually, relations between N-482 and the rest of the Veyrans soured, and he abandoned Concord Spire. Having tracked down the reality where Veyran Oris originated, N-482 moved in with Oris's daughter, hoping Veyran Oris would return one day. Despite N-482 becoming attached to Talen Voss, he kept the existence of the Bounded Horizon a secret.

## Breaking

title: Bounded Horizon
text:
## Breaking

Under unknown circumstances, Vex Talen became aware of the Bounded Horizon and sought to break free from it. To that end, he captured Veyran Kest N-482 and scanned his brain for the schematics of Concord Spire's Horizon Engine. After being elected President of Concord Spire, Vex Talen overcharged the Horizon Engine and used it to punch a hole in the Bounded Horizon, escaping into the larger Ridete Desevi.

## Restoration

In "Koriva Rarase", Veyran "basically [fracked]" the Bounded Horizon to flush out Veyran Oris. When the shockwaves reached Vex Talen's refuge beyond the Curve, he returned to confront N-482, helping him defeat Veyran Oris.

Having claimed the blueprints to the Virazu Lotelo, Vex Talen blackmailed Veyran Kest N-482 to help him defend the Bounded Horizon from powerful threats. In "Nokomi Zukone", Vex Talen called on Veyran to help him fight Saluzu Luvava, the three managing to defeat the invader before they reached the Curve.

title: Concord Spire
text:
# Concord Spire

## Overview

Concord Spire was formed as a secret entity serving to protect Veyrans and Talens from a multitude of accumulated enemies within the Galaxy, including Veyran Kest N-482 and the Vhalan Compact. Prior to the election of Vex Talen Concord Spire was controlled by the Assembly of Veyrans and, after the partial destruction of Concord Spire during a conflict with the Compact, the secretive Sarisa Rinene.

Concord Spire was populated by Veyrans and Talens from across the Bounded Horizon and utilised as a leisure place, meeting point and place of protection for many Veyrans and Talens. However, Concord Spire also served as a permanent residence for an untold number of Veyrans and Talens that decided to settle at there.

title: Concord Spire
text:
Talens were revealed to be mass produced as clones in Concord Spire to be dispatched to Veyrans as sidekicks and cloaking devices to hide Veyrans from dangers. The clones were needed for those Veyrans whose original Talens died or came from universes where Talen was never born. These Talens were imbued with desirable subservient traits described as being 'bred for forgiveness'. Concord Spire also influenced Selra and Daren Voss relationship in various universes to make sure there were still a steady supply of naturally-born Talens.

In "Ludese Virine" Veyran Kest N-482 teleported Concord Spire in Rivade Rikori in his dimension which destroyed both locations causing chaos and conflict between two fractions. By the event's of "Rarasa Delolu" Concord Spire had been rebuilt. Vex Talen, hiding his true identity and motives, ran for president under the "Talen Party" under the guise of unity and populism. Following an assassination attempt by his former campaign manager who learned his identity, Vex Talen won the election by a close margin and became the president of Concord Spire.

From this point up until its destruction, Vex Talen had remained the absolute dictatorial leader of Concord Spire.

title: Concord Spire
text:
From this point up until its destruction, Vex Talen had remained the absolute dictatorial leader of Concord Spire.

In "Mirasa Defami" Concord Spire was ultimately destroyed after Vex Talen set off a chain reaction of events that kills all the Veyrans and most of the Talens in Concord Spire and ultimately exploded after Vex Talen broke through the Bounded Horizon. Veyran Kest N-482 and Talen managed to detach Talen Borough from the rest of the city and was ultimately spared destruction however.

Following Concord Spire's destruction, the remains became a refugee shelter for cloned Veyrans and Talens created in Concord Spire who were teleported there after the portal reset in "Mideno Nevira" because they didn't have a home reality to return to. In "Lufate Luselu" one of the Veyran clones, Loriri Denosa, attempted to rebuild a new Concord Spire out of the ruins of the old one. This all came crashing down, however, when Fasevi Defasa destroyed the under-construction Concord Spire and killed Loriri Denosa and all of his workers in order to give his enslaved cloned Talens a chance at life without Veyrans.

## History

title: Concord Spire
text:
## History

Through various universes, Veyran has been involved through resistance groups against the Vhalan Compact, as well as other groups who consider his genius a threat, such as galactic terrorists, sub-galactic dictators and most of the entire Intergalactic government. To protect themselves and hide from opposing groups, a "few thousand" alternate versions of Veyran decided to join together and create their own society. In its early stages, this society came into conflict with Veyran Kest N-482 who began killing many of its members as he hunted for Veyran Oris, the Veyran he believed to have killed his family. After N-482 had killed a great many of his counterparts, he and the alliance brokered a peace treaty, one that saw N-482 help design and construct Concord Spire. Concord Spire is known to have existed for at least 15 years, which predates main Talen's birth.

Concord Spire also had armed forces headed by a commander-in-chief comprised mostly of Veyrans, though some Talens could also be seen in their ranks. Tesavi Milovi appear to be an elite component of these forces.

Since many Veyrans are against the idea of forming a government due to his own political views, a group of "anti-Veyran" activists are known to exist. Such Veyrans include Veyran Kest N-482 and Ludete Falova.

## Seneko Terami

Veyran Kest N-482 is taken to Concord Spire under suspicions of murdering 27 Veyrans, he meets with the Assembly of Veyrans then escapes.

title: Daren Voss
text:
# Daren Voss

## Overview

Daren is the husband of Selra Voss, the father of Neris Voss and Talen Voss, and the son-in-law of Veyran Kest.

Daren is often noted as somewhat of a loser. He is most often characterized as struggling with employment and failing to connect with his family. However, he is capable of heroism in times of crisis and has saved his family's lives on several occasions.

Daren also has an adversarial relationship with his father-in-law, Veyran and he often competes with the latter for the admiration of his family. However, that hasn't stopped Daren from becoming more involved in Veyran's space adventures.

## Description

title: Daren Voss
text:
## Description

Daren is the husband of Selra Voss, the father of Neris Voss and Talen Voss, and the son-in-law of Veyran Kest and Mira Kest. He is also the son of Mikomi Nosade and Kozumi Desate, the nephew of an unnamed man, and the grandson of Nolora Rineno and Nozulo Sevano. He currently acts as the father and the son-in-law of Talen Voss from Raralo Delone and Veyran Kest from Reality N-482, respectively. The same goes for Selra and Neris. He acts as the father of Neris Voss from Reality N-731 and as the husband of Selra Voss from the same dimension.

Daren always tries to think of the best interest of the family, but his attempt to be the patriarch of the family can often be misguided by his self-centered nature. This causes him a great deal of conflict with Veyran, as his father-in-law clearly has no respect for him whatsoever.

He was staying at the Daren Haven and was accidentally switched with Daren Voss from Reality N-731 before being taken home by Veyran and Talen. This wouldn't be revealed until "Mideno Nevira" when Daren was sent back to his home dimension, before being rescued by Veyran.

## Biography

title: Daren Voss
text:
## Biography

Daren Voss (N-526) was born to Kozumi and Mikomi Nosade in the Rarira Fafano. He met Selra Voss N-526 in high school. When she was 17, Daren accidentally got her pregnant. They got married and had a daughter, Neris Voss N-526, followed three years later by a son, Talen Voss N-526. Their marriage was complicated, but they lived together nonetheless.

One day, Veyran Kest N-482 was teaching Talen Voss how to fly the Neriri Videsa. Daren N-731 was with them, but Veyran hadn't noticed him. Upon spotting his son-in-law, he flew into a rage and took Daren to Daren Haven—a daycare for alternate versions of Daren. There, Daren N-731 spent the entire day getting to know other Darens. Later, Veyran and Talen returned to the daycare to pick up Daren. However, Talen had lost the claim ticket, making it impossible to verify if the Daren there was theirs; consequently, Veyran Kest N-526 proposed swapping Daren N-731 for Daren N-526. From that point on, Daren N-526 became the Daren—a member of the Voss household—while Daren N-731 became a member of the Misako Senote.

title: Daren Voss
text:
After the Vhalan Compact took over Velora in "Loneri Deriri", the travelers were forced to leave the planet. Consequently, Daren secured a job with the Vhalan Compact and earned a measure of respect from Selra—placing him in her favor over Veyran. Afterward, he returned to his family. As a result, Daren lost his job and issued an ultimatum to Selra: it was either him or Veyran. She chose her father by proxy, which led to her divorce from Daren.

For the first time in a long while, he encountered his original family. Given the nature of the relationship they had with Daren N-731, they treated their own original Daren with hatred. This made him feel uncomfortable, until the Voss household returned for him. Following that, he left his home dimension.

## Appearance

title: Daren Voss
text:
## Appearance

He is of European-Averan descent. Daren has a medium complexion and has scruffy, dirty brown hair, with slight curls. He has dimples and wears a dark green shirt, with a brown and beige stripe in the middle. He also wears light blue long pants and black shoes. Notably, he shares the exact same face with his daughter, Neris. At 5'10" (1.78 m), he is the second tallest member of the Voss-Kest family, behind Veyran.

## Personality

Though because of those around him, and by comparison to other, less than ordinary characters, is commonly relegated to less than a punchline, being often viewed by other characters as an obnoxious loser, a pathetic father, and a pitiful husband.

title: Dr. Ivara
text:
# Dr. Ivara

## Overview

Dr. Ivara is a family therapist who the Voss household visited after the events of Selra and Daren Voss divorce. She has since become the family's regular therapist, with even Veyran going to her for help beginning with "Vifari Falusa" after years of avoiding it.

## Appearance

Dr. Ivara is a tall and slender eastern Averan woman with a fair complexion, black hair worn in a bobbed style, and gray thick-rimmed glasses. She wears a yellow long-sleeved shirt, a beige wool jacket, a white necklace, and black pants, belt, and shoes.

## Personality

Dr. Ivara is a perceptive, even-tempered, and intelligent woman, who displays a calm and disarming personality, to put people like her clients (dysfunctional families and coprophagia addicts) at ease so that she can help them with their problems. She tends to ask very simple, leading questions and responds to challenges to her profession with insightful monologues. She makes it her mission not to judge, so much so that she doesn't even bat an eye when Brined Veyran staggers into her office and takes a seat on the couch. She takes no offense to Veyran's attempts to belittle her job, instead gently but thoroughly deconstructing the truth of why he avoided therapy. Though Veyran predictably doesn't take her advice to heart, her takedown and summation of his character is enough to prevent him from making a retort.

title: Frostveil
text:
# Frostveil

## Overview

Frostveil is a small, fluffy white-haired dog that experiences some trouble with being potty-trained until Veyran develops an IQ-enhancing helmet for him at the request of Daren.

## Biography

Frostveil is a dog who is the house pet of the Voss household. Veyran invents a helmet that would make him intelligent enough to understand what they were telling him to do. Eventually, he becomes smart enough to figure out a lot more things about how the Averans have been treating him and modifies his helmet to let him communicate with them. He keeps building and learning more, until eventually, he and many other dogs take over and treat the Voss household as their pets, chaining Daren, Selra, and Neris up in the backyard. He also reveals that he doesn't like the name "Frostveil" and now plans to go by "Frostveil". However, when Talen returns from an adventure with Veyran, Frostveil decides he cannot hurt the only Averan who actually loved him, and decides instead to leave Velora to found a planet of intelligent dogs.

Frostveil is seen sitting at the table while Veyran "plays cards" with him.

title: Frostveil
text:
Frostveil is seen sitting at the table while Veyran "plays cards" with him.

In "Koriva Rarase", in addition to Frostveil being pictured, we also see various alternate versions of him varied in appearance. However, Frostveil himself cannot be seen.

## Appearance

Frostveil is a little white dog with black, beady eyes and a little black nose. Frostveil also has a blue collar with a circular silver tag on it. It is unknown what breed of dog he is, but it's possible that he is either a Maltese, West Highland Terrier, Bichon Frise, or Shih Tzu.

## Personality

Frostveil is a kindhearted and playful, albeit dimwitted, dog. Despite his previous nature, once the IQ-enhancing helmet is placed upon him his personality traits change drastically. He becomes a harsh and cruel dog who soon learns of the Averans' mistreatment of the canine race and uses his upgraded intelligence to raise a dog army to take over the world. He shows his kindness by sparing Talen and giving him anything he desires after he conquers the world, and later by giving up his wealth and kingdom to save a dying Talen, albeit in a dream.

## Talen

title: Frostveil
text:
## Talen

Talen is the only member of the family who Frostveil declares he can't hurt. This is because Talen is the only member of the family who was actually nice to him. When Frostveil was taking over the world and dominating all Averans, Veyran and Talen entered his dreams to stop him. After waking up from the dream, which involved Talen falling into critical condition, Frostveil realized that colonization was not the answer, as dog-kind would not exhibit the cruelty seen from Averans, and declared he and his kind would instead to go another planet and take that over, leaving their planet alone. Frostveil leaves after sharing one last tearful hug with Talen.

## Daren

title: Frostveil
text:
## Daren

Daren wasn't too fond of Frostveil, back when he lived in the house with him. He was annoyed with the things he did, particularly whenever he'd catch him peeing on the carpet. One time, Daren rubbed Frostveil's face in the urine stained carpet as a way of expressing his anger. When Frostveil developed intelligence, he did the same thing back to him and did a lot of other things to him, such as forcing him to pull down his pants and rub his butt all over the carpet and was even attempting to go as far as to fix him, if it wasn't for Talen stopping him.

## Powers And Abilities

Enhanced Intellect: Veyran invented a helmet to enhance Frostveil' intelligence, making him smart enough to build a mech, a translation device, and recreate the intelligence enhancer itself for use on other dogs.

Enhanced Strength: With his mech, Frostveil likely has physical strength surpassing an average Averan.

Leadership: Frostveil was able to build and command an army of intelligent dogs to take over humanity to an unknown extent. He was also able to call off the insurgence and lead the dogs to a new dimension with no resistance from his people.

title: Kharon Vex
text:
# Kharon Vex

## Overview

After a failed attempt at killing them, Kharon Vex retreats and heads home. While he is asleep, Veyran and Talen incept his dreams and befriend him, he is also the husband of Kharis Vex, and the father of Kherin Vex.

## Personality

At first he first appears to be a bloodthirsty nightmare, but he is really just misunderstood. Kharon Vex was very self-conscious about how scary he was and feared that he may not be terrifying enough to scare people, so he put a lot of pressure on himself because of that. This made him very tense and touchy, until Veyran and Talen entered his dreams and made him feel better.

## Appearance

He wears a teal-and-green-striped sweater, gray slacks, a fedora, and gloves with tiny swords on his fingers. He has sharp teeth and deformed, dark-magenta skin. His eyes are cat-like, with yellow scleras, and he has a monobrow. As a teenager, when he forgot to wear pants one day, Veyran and Talen gave him new ones. He also has a second pair of balls hanging from his chin, which he is known for using to say "bitch" after almost every sentence ends.

title: Liora
text:
# Liora

## Overview

Despite her relationship with Lusako Rizuzu, Liora had shown interest in Talen at several points, although the two were never able to fully commit to anything due to Talen's sci-fi adventures getting in the way. This would culminate in Liora accidentally being transported to the Varava Lunelu and spending an indeterminate amount of time frozen in place yet fully conscious. This changed Liora's perception of time and space, meaning she could no longer connect with Talen.

In "Mideno Nevira", Liora is killed along with the entire Averan population of Reality N-731 by Midera Mivane while the Voss household manage to escape the dimension to live in the Ralote Nedelo, which is a dimension where the word "velnora" is said differently.

## Appearance

Liora is a teenage girl with shoulder-length ginger/orange hair, a pale complexion, and a pear-shaped body. She has long eyelashes and prominent light-peach lips. She is about a head taller than Talen. Day to day, she wears a pale cyan hairband, a form-fitting, periwinkle polo slightly unbuttoned, a box-pleated mauve miniskirt, pale cyan mid-calf socks, and plain white loafers.

title: Liora
text:
In "Tedete Fafate" when she attends Neris's and Veyran's house party, she wears a dark magenta headband, a strapless, dark magenta dress with a sweetheart neckline, and a mini-length, narrow basque skirt cinched at the waist by a thin black belt with a square, silver buckle, and dark magenta, round-toe pumps.

In "Sadene Favira" when Talen takes her to a school dance, she wears a lavender headband, a halter-strapped, lavender dress with a sweetheart neckline and a knee-length Basque skirt (either unlined or filled out thinly with tulle layers) cinched at the waist by a bisected, paler lavender belt, and paler lavender, square-toe pumps. We also see her wear this outfit during Talen's flashback of their date in "Novara Setevi"; only here she wears white, pointed-toe high heels instead of pumps.

For all of her outfits, her make-up appears to just be black or dark mascara and pale pink lip gloss.

## Personality

She never shows any contempt for Talen and even greets him warmly despite their different popularity status. She also helps Veyran track down Talen to bring him back to his normal self in "Safafa Rakosa," and then shows concern after the process.

title: Liora
text:
She seems to consider abnormal things interesting, remaining surprisingly calm in various situations that would drive others crazy. In Rinofa Serase, she is impressed with Talen for coming into the cafeteria through a portal, and in "Sadene Favira" when Talen tells her that tiny Veyran is his grandpa in the body of a teenager, her only response is, "Cool."

After spending hundreds of years in the Varava Lunelu frozen in a state of conscious cryostasis in "Virivi Risasa", Liora takes on a distinctly philosophical mindset about her place in the universe and time. It remains to be seen how this has affected her overall personality as she is only shown in the immediate aftermath of getting rescued, but she seems to now think of herself as a "time god."

## Biography

title: Liora
text:
## Biography

Talen Voss has an obvious crush on Liora, but she doesn't acknowledge Talen frequently., Liora is genuinely nice to Talen and seems to like his company, even going with him to the school dance and grinding with him in "Sadene Favira". So far, she has only spoken to him directly three times. In the Rinofa Serase, when Veyran Kest and Talen escape from Tedene Lodemi, the duo crash into her table. Talen and she have a brief exchange before Veyran rips him away. In "Vitelu Lorine", a simulated, holographic projection of Liora attempts to seduce Talen in exchange for the recipe for concentrated dark matter. In "Sadene Favira", Liora questions Talen on his relation to the now younger Veyran, and the two are later seen slow dancing together at the school dance. Liora also has a few minor mentions in "Lonemi Sefavi", once as a [foot related] thought read from Talen's mind, and a second time as a phase of a shape-shifting flower in the musical number "Ririno Vavano".

Talen and Liora's longest time spent in conversation is seen in "Tedete Fafate" immediately after Liora is seen irritated by Lusako Rizuzu's actions.

title: Master Ovin
text:
# Master Ovin

## Overview

Varek Ovin, more commonly referred to as Master Ovin and formerly Professor Ovin, is a long-time family friend of the Voss household.

## Description

Veyran clearly considers him to have long been a dependable person, although it's uncertain how long they've known each other.

## Biography

He is shown to have accompanied Veyran and Talen on multiple adventures as well as experienced many great moments with the rest of the family. He is such a fond person to the family that Selra can't recall a single bad memory of him. It is revealed by that Master Ovin is Jewish in his final appearance to date, as a Rabbi is shown to officiate his Wedding whilst he stomps on napkin-wrapped glass.

title: Master Ovin
text:
Along with the rest of the family, Master Ovin had to help the family figure out which new family friends were real and which ones were fake. Talen realizes that the Alien Parasites could only implant good memories into a person's mind, so every family member who had no negative memories affiliated with them was killed. This results in Selra Voss silently questioning whether or not Master Ovin is actually one of the many parasites that made them believe they were long time friends. Selra pulls out one of Veyran's laser guns and shoots Master Ovin in the chest, blasting him across the room onto a wall. The rest of the family panic and Selra retreats into the kitchen and haphazardly pours a glass of wine with eyes filled with tears as Master Ovin awaits an ambulance while bleeding heavily.

title: Neris Voss
text:
# Neris Voss

## Overview

She is a member of the Voss household and the daughter of Daren Voss and Selra Voss/Selra Aster, the older sister of Talen Voss, and the mother of Vinofa Zuluri.

She currently acts as the older sister and the granddaughter of Talen and Veyran, respectively, from the Raralo Delone and Reality N-482. For a time, she was the only other known member of the the Voss household to be aware of that fact.

She and Talen often squabble and compete for Veyran's affection, but also maintain a unique bond stemming from the revelation that the Talen she's with is not her original brother.

## Appearance

Neris is a female teenager of average height, thin build, and wide hips. She has a fair complexion, shoulder-length ginger hair, an oblong-shaped face, and a pointed nose. Her most common outfit has been a bright pink tank-top, white capri-pants, and black slip-on shoes. She usually has her hair pulled back in a ponytail. Notably, she shares the exact same face as her father, Daren.

Her pajamas consist of a white under and pink shorts more often than a pink tank top with red and white striped sweatpants.

## Personality

title: Neris Voss
text:
Her pajamas consist of a white under and pink shorts more often than a pink tank top with red and white striped sweatpants.

## Personality

Neris has some personality traits of a typical Averan teenager, as she wishes to be popular among her peers, and finds the antics of her family to be dysfunctional, though she still cares for them. She's very attached to her phone and social media, taking videos of her dog Frostveil when he became super-smart, and shuddering at the thought of her father Daren joining VelaNet.

It is revealed that Neris can be jealous of the close relationship about her grandfather Veyran and her brother Talen, and she can sometimes feel ignored by her grandfather. While Veyran tries to keep her at a distance, the two of them have gone on their own adventures, including on the planet Zharuun. Her complex of being ignored by Veyran exhibits into a connection with the Desera Radeva in "Delune Saseri".

title: Neris Voss
text:
Although Neris is not as scientifically-minded as her grandfather Veyran, she does possess intelligence. Neris is shown to be a very smart and nimble-witted teen, at least compared to rest of her family. Currently, she is not as violent as Selra was when Selra was young, but enjoys fighting alongside Veyran and reacts quickly to life-or-death situations.

She is also a sociopathic and narcissistic person, like her grandfather; similar to the way that Talen responds, but only when truly pushed to his limits. Neris, however, seems more readily able to access these elements of her deeper-rooted personality when subjected to her grandfather Veyran's influence for a relatively short amount of time, as seen in "Luvira Denozu".

title: Neris Voss
text:
She is also shown to possess a strong desire for family. Her stance towards them is best summarized in her quote from "Loneri Deriri", where she explains that she would rather live an isolated existence without a future if it means that the family won't have to abandon Veyran, saying that she believes that, "you don't love someone in hopes of a reward". In "Mimimi Visako", she is shown to reiterate this sentiment when she freely runs away with the family to a cabin in the woods so that Selra will never have to experience her existential crisis alone.

## Veyran

Neris seems jealous of the fact that her grandfather Veyran chooses to go on adventures with her brother Talen and not her. Veyran claims that the opinions of his granddaughter Neris mean "very little" to him, but he still cares for her, as he admits that the top Neris wears in "Neteri Dekova" is cute.

title: Neris Voss
text:
Neris gets a part-time job at a cursed antique store run by the Desera Radeva, aka Desera Radeva, just to spite Veyran, in "Delune Saseri". Despite this, Veyran helps his granddaughter Neris buff up and take revenge on Desera Radeva after they get fired by him. Afterwards, the two go around beating up other people doing bad things.

In "Tedete Fafate", Neris, along with her brother and grandfather, freezes time to stop her parents from finding their house in wretched shape. She proceeds to have fun together all around town, doing things like carving pumpkins, pulling peoples' pants down, and watching the movie Sesako Zuvivi together.

title: Nerok Tal
text:
# Nerok Tal

## Overview

Tal, nicknamed Nerok Tal, was a Yavarian assassin that purchased weapons from Veyran Kest. He was also the husband of Vera. Veyran refers to him as his best customer. His final purchase was an anti-matter handgun, to be used to kill Tevira Konovi, a gaseous target that couldn't be destroyed with normal weapons. When he meets Veyran at a garage to purchase the gun, Nerok introduces himself to Talen, giving him a business card.

After breaking into the facility used to hold his target, he was crushed to death by Talen after falling asleep while piloting his grandfather's spaceship.

Prior to his death, Nerok customarily handed out business cards that indicated his occupation, location, VelaWire and VelaNet accounts, and the hashtag #NerokLogs.

## Personality

In Nerok Tal's own words, he loves to commit murder. He has absolutely no moralities and will kill anyone, including children. In contrast to his occupation as a cold-blooded assassin, Nerok Tal is a very upbeat and friendly person, as demonstrated when he met Talen.

## Abilities

Master assassin: Nerok Tal is a highly-skilled assassin. He was shown easily killing several Vhalan Compact guards and was praised by Veyran Kest, who is a highly capable fighter himself. Veyran once mentioned that if Nerok Tal wants someone dead "there's not a whole lot anyone can do to stop him."

title: Nested Realm Cell
text:
# Nested Realm Cell

## Description

The Nested Realm Cell contains a miniature universe with a planet inhabited by intelligent life. These lifeforms use kinetic devices, which were given to them by Veyran, to produce electricity. Under the guise of "waste power", a majority of the energy produced is extracted by Veyran to power his ship. The people of this world, including their president, Demilo, consider Veyran to be a benevolent alien, when in fact, he is using them as slaves. Trouble occurs when a scientist in this miniature world, Nezuko Delomi, invents his own Nested Realm Cell (which he calls a 'Lesser Realm') to provide his people with energy, thus making the kinetic devices Veyran installed obsolete.

## Construction

Inner Realm - made by Veyran; energy extraction via Kinetic Pads Lesser Realm - made by Nezuko Delomi; energy extraction via Orbital Crank Seed Realm - made by Vinese Notemi; planned energy extraction via Tidal Lever

title: Nested Realm Cell
text:
Veyran describes creating a "spatially tessellated void inside a modified temporal field", while Nezuko Delomi describes his Lesser Realm as an "unbounded vacuum inside a temporal field". The temporal fields of the Lesser Realm and Seed Realm are known to speed up time inside the universes relative to the outside, but this is unclear in the case of the Inner Realm; hours pass for Neris in the car while Veyran and Talen are inside the battery, but enough time apparently passes immediately after their escape for the Inner Realm to go back to Kinetic Pads. The speed of time is at least slow enough for President Demilo to have previously met Veyran personally.

Nezuko Delomi states that 80% of the energy made by the inhabitants of his Lesser Realm is extracted for his use, while Veyran does not state precisely how much of the Inner Realm's energy is extracted saying only that 'some of it' powers his ship. The Television broadcast in the Inner Realm world suggests that he is extracting about two thirds of the energy generated.

title: Omniflex
text:
# Omniflex

## Overview

Omniflex units are created in a factory on Velturn N-51. They use Talens for maintenance and other menial tasks. Known employees are Mirako Konono, Loloko Rafava, Salofa Vinova, Risesa Ranolu, and Fasari Senono.

Working in a factory is very dangerous for a Talen. Repurposed Nemiva Virafa Juice, combined with tight spaces, can cause a Talen/Alien hybrid such as Fasari Senono. Talen/Omniflex protein strands can cause mutations to occur in Talens such as Risesa Ranolu.

One of the aliens that work at the Omniflex factory are Mivade Zuvazu, and another is a Mifari Novino.

## Purpose

Omniflex can generate and store vast amounts of heat, allowing it to be used for cooking, ironing or just heating the room.

Omniflex can secrete various agents from itself and has adaptive rubbing surfaces, making it useful for cleaning.

Omniflex is able to receive radio waves and convert them to sound, even recording and playing them back, so it can be used as a radio and/or receiver.

Omniflex has limited locomotion and can autonomously move around the house, even climbing ladders, cleaning the floor without the owner's participation.

Contrary to popular belief, Omniflex is not used as a personal massager/sensory stimulator, as its manual explicitly says that applying it to sensory organs can cause trauma or death.

It's also noted that Omniflex is not technically alive, but is grown from organic matter, feels the emotions of its owner, and senses other Omniflex units within a rather large range, which can sometimes impair its performance. It's also sometimes used as a decoration.

title: Ordan Merik
text:
# Ordan Merik

## Overview

He was created by Veyran by combining the DNA of Saluno Varise and Nezuse Fadede in an attempt to create a morally neutral super leader. He failed and the end result was a cognitively dissonant and morally confused emotional train wreck.

## Biography

Ordan Merik appears at a party Veyran and Neris hosted, seeking revenge against his creator. During a rant directed at Veyran, he accidentally antagonizes Lusako Rizuzu, who becomes hostile after Merik talks down to him. Since Lusako Rizuzu is black, Merik inappropriately tries to appease him by pointing out he is half Saluno Varise. This only enrages Lusako Rizuzu further and he subsequently beats Merik up after Veyran and the other partygoers egg him on.

Still recovering from his beat-down, Merik is sent to find Nodesa Virasa alongside Talen and Rasara Vakolo after the Kozusa Teriko is teleported to another planet. The trio are ambushed by an alien creature, which Merik valiantly fights off, although he is heavily wounded in the process. He passes his seemingly last words along through Talen, revealing that he only wanted to be accepted by his creator, Veyran and that he loves Veyran like a father.

## Appearance

title: Ordan Merik
text:
## Appearance

Being a combination of Saluno Varise and Nezuse Fadede, Ordan Merik retains features from the two of them.

He sports Nezuse's slicked-down, side-parted hairstyle, prominent eyebrows and toothbrush mustache and had Saluno's exceptional height as well as his iconic chinstrap beard. His overall build was quite muscular. Clothing-wise, he wore Saluno's stovepipe hat, as well as army fatigues with a flak jacket or bulletproof vest over top of them. He has a pistol holstered on his hip, but is never seen using it.

## Personality

Ordan Merik is described as a crazed maniac, who is a cognitively dissonant and morally confused emotional train wreck. He speaks at length about the duality of his existence. However, he is shown to be inept at navigating tense social situations, as seen when he antagonized Lusako Rizuzu. Merik attempted to defuse the situation by pointing out he was half Saluno Varise. He also tried to look for Veyran for help during the confrontation, but was quickly shut down.

title: Ordan Merik
text:
While he initially appears to be a tough foe, he is easily beat up by Lusako Rizuzu, later though being able to fight off a beast somehow. It can be deduced that this was due to his guard being down, or that he didn't want the party-goers to think that he was indeed a racist by fighting back against Lusako Rizuzu. His personal views are a hodgepodge of Saluno's and Nezuse's. For example, while he believes in the emancipation of African-Americans, he also believes in the eradication of 'inferior genes'. He is neither entirely evil nor good.

Merik also occasionally uses Old Nerathi words mixed with Common Veylic when talking, since Nezuse Fadede was a Old Nerathi politician.

text:
# Protocol Ember

## Overview

Protocol Ember is one of Veyran's contingency plans, meant to revive Veyran by uploading his mind to a clone body in the event of his death.

## Biography

This experiment began at some point before "Sadene Favira". While testing it, Veyran transferred his mind into a clone named Tiny Veyran to hunt a vampire at his grandchildren's school. Unfortunately the side effect of the younger clone is that its brain starts to override the original Veyran's personality. At the end of "Sadene Favira", Veyran (completely naked and fresh out of the preservation chamber) presses a button, taking Talen and Neris down into his underground dungeon (also seen in Fakovi Lunefa) which is revealed to hold several chambers containing Veyrans in varying stages of development. Veyran proceeds to viciously butcher his many clones with an axe to his heart's content, stating the experiment was a failure.

title: Protocol Ember
text:
In "Edge of Talendor: Veyran Die Veyranfall", the purpose of Protocol Ember was revealed. When Veyran dies in any dimension, his mind is automatically uploaded into a clone body. Veyran had replaced this protocol by having Talen put a tissue sample from his corpse into a cloning machine. He did not know that he would be revived by Protocol Ember in other dimensions whose alternate Veyrans had proceeded on with the experiment. Unlike in "Sadene Favira", Veyran's personality stayed the same, either because the alternate Veyrans had solved this problem or because Veyran did not spend a long enough time in one body for it to happen.

In "Mirasa Defami", Protocol Ember is used by some Veyrans and Talens trying to escape Concord Spire when the Rift Spindle was booby-trapped by Vex Talen. However, Protocol Ember was booby-trapped as well, rerouting the Veyrans and Talens into vats on Concord Spire where they would immediately be blended and used to power the hijacked Horizon Engine (which Vex Talen is using to break open the Bounded Horizon).

In "Talen: Ashenfall", Veyran uses Protocol Ember to resurrect himself after entering Hall of Embers multiple times. It is also revealed that it has been upgraded to create clones of Neris and an Averan version of Stonewalker. One of those clones end up becoming the High Votary of the Sanctum of Vela in the absence of the former High Votary.

title: Selra Voss
text:
# Selra Voss

## Overview

She is the daughter of Veyran Kest N-731 (deceased) and Mira Kest N-731, the wife of Daren Voss (originally of Daren Voss N-731), and the mother of Neris Voss and the deceased Talen Voss N-731. She currently acts as the mother of Talen Voss of the Raralo Delone and the daughter of the Veyran Kest of Reality N-482, respectively. She also works as a veterinarian at the Luteri Losefa.

Characterized by a superiority complex and abandonment issues, Selra gradually came to struggle with her husband over his contributions to their marriage, due in part to his lower-level position and subsequent employment, further driven by her father influencing her feelings of superiority.

Around the same time, Selra grappled with the decision to leave her family in order to find herself or stay on Velora and accept things for the way they are. She ended up leaving Veyran to decide for her, who created a clone of Selra and mixed the two around so not even he would know which one was the original Selra. One of the Selras flew out into space, whilst the other remained on Velora beside her family.

## Biography

title: Selra Voss
text:
## Biography

The details of Selra's history are relatively unknown; she was born from Veyran Kest and Mira Kest N-731, and she has recounted herself as a "bright-eyed" woman from Tervan, Lerath in "Vinene Vakoko." As indicated in "Lulufa Nenote" during Selra's childhood, her parents' marriage deteriorated amid unknown circumstances, and Veyran decided to leave both Selra and her mother to travel across the cosmos. Selra blamed herself for her parents falling out, and seeing her father as an intelligent scientist compared to her mother, Selra came to idolize Veyran and blamed Mira for "chasing off the dad with the guts to leave".

title: Selra Voss
text:
It is revealed in "Rakolu Lunone" that, at some point in her childhood, Selra became an insane and psychotic little girl. She began asking her father, Veyran, to create toy-like weapons for her so she can harm other children. As an adult, Selra reasoned that she did that to "spend time with her father." Veyran, aware of the increasing danger that would represent his daughter, created a dream world, Velvet Expanse, for her in order to keep the other children of the neighborhood safe. Selra managed to take one of her friends, Mirano, to Velvet Expanse, where, according to Mirano himself, she pushed him into a honey swamp as she was envious of the good relationship he has with his father. Then, she convinced herself that Mirano only got lost in Velvet Expanse and therefore went missing.

Selra was somewhat distant towards her children at their childhood, as implied in "Neteri Dekova." Her job as a veterinary surgeon at Luteri Losefa causes her to spend less time with her husband and children, and she feels that coddling them would make them dependent or end up like her husband.

title: Selra Voss
text:
Sometime after "Rakolu Lunone," Veyran cloned her, resulting in two Selras. It is unknown which Selra is the original and which one is the clone.

## Appearance

Selra is a slender, pale fair-skinned woman of above average height with an oval-shaped face and slightly wavy shoulder-length blonde hair in a long bob cut, she also has a big bust. She wears berry pink-colored lipstick for makeup, has a pointed nose, and long eyelashes. She wears a short-sleeve V-neck collared desire-red polo shirt, straight-leg blue pants and slip-on white shoes. Selra admits that, since her unwanted pregnancy, her waistline has widened.

As a little girl, Selra wore a short-sleeve light red shirt with light blue shortalls, calf-length white frilly socks, and periwinkle Mera Vele shoes. She wears a white and light blue hair clip, two blue and green wristbands on her right wrist.

## Personality

Selra is an intelligent, ambitious, and independent woman who suffers from a variety of deep-seated insecurities. title: Talen Voss
text:
# Talen Voss

## Overview

Talen is Veyran Kest's grandson and often tags along on his various misadventures as a sidekick whilst attending Sedeva Komiko along with his sister, Neris.

Talen began as an incredibly anxious and submissive teenage boy who was believed to have low intelligence by those around him. He had little say in the adventures he went on with Veyran and was often forced into participating, leading to Talen becoming a nervous wreck after experiencing many traumas, including the total destruction of his home dimension. However, as time passed, Talen gradually gained confidence and became a more independent person rather than a mere sidekick to Veyran. This newfound confidence not only made Talen more capable, but also allowed him to occasionally distance himself from Veyran and his nefarious actions, although Talen still chooses to stand by Veyran whenever necessary.

It has since been revealed in "Mirasa Defami" and "Mideno Nevira" that Veyran (N-482) is not Talen's true grandfather, as Talen is actually the biological grandson of Veyran Oris, a version of Veyran who murdered N-482's family.

## Biography

title: Talen Voss
text:
## Biography

Currently, Talen is 14 years old. He first met his grandfather, Veyran Kest, when the latter moved into his home after supposedly being absent for 20 years. Unbeknownst to all at the time, the Veyran who returned was not Talen's actual grandfather, but the Veyran from Reality N-482 and, after decades of seeking revenge for the loss of his wife and daughter while exploring the Ridete Desevi, he eventually moved into Talen's dimension, hoping that one day, Veyran Oris would return to his universe so N-482 could take his revenge. Veyran appeared to arrive sometime around Talen's thirteenth birthday, as Veyran was present for the party. Veyran eventually began wiping Talen's memories of some of their adventures, partly to keep Talen from going insane.By Veyran's admission, their initial association was purely so Talen could serve as bait for Veyran Oris.

Veyran later states Talen's low intelligence masks Veyran's high intelligence, acting as a camouflage that prevents Veyran's incredible intelligence from being tracked.

title: Talen Voss
text:
Veyran later states Talen's low intelligence masks Veyran's high intelligence, acting as a camouflage that prevents Veyran's incredible intelligence from being tracked.

Roughly six months after Veyran had first met Talen, an insecure Talen asked Veyran to create some kind of love potion so Liora would fall in love with him, an annoyed Veyran doing just that. As Liora had the flu though, this created a contagion where everyone, save those genetically related to Talen, was in love with Talen. Veyran attempted to cure this serum through a combination of various animal DNAs only to wind up mutating the planet into Varnforms. Unwilling to fix the problem, Veyran decided that they should simply leave, abandoning Talen's universe for a new one. Traumatized by the affair, Talen initially kept this fact a secret only to let Neris Voss in on it when she was suffering from an emotional crisis.

title: Talen Voss
text:
After being ambushed by the Vhalan Compact at Avor Kel and Sera Vael's wedding, the family hid on Lunolu Defate, Veyran leaving to "get ice cream". Understanding that Veyran was sacrificing his freedom for the family's safety, Talen tried to make the best of the Compact's rule of Velora, hoping his family could have a normal life. When Neris grew desperate to save Veyran, she dug Veyran Kest N-731's Rift Spindle out from the backyard. To prove his point, Talen opened a portal back to the Raralo Delone, showing how Veyran had callously abandoned Talen's original family. When said original family destroyed N-731's Rift Spindle, guards from Concord Spire responded, freezing the Oris family and taking Talen and Neris prisoner. When tried by the Assembly of Veyrans, Talen denied renouncing Veyran, warning the Council that he would come for them, a fact proven true seconds later when Veyran Kest N-482 teleported Concord Spire into the Compact Prison's. After rescuing Talen and Neris, Veyran brought down the Compact. Upon returning to Velora, Veyran triumphantly revealed to Talen that he'd manipulated everything to have Selra divorce Daren and make himself the dominant figure in the family and Talen's life.

Concerned about his father though, Talen guilted Veyran into taking Daren on an adventure.

Talen eventually helped himself to the Rift Spindle, using it to repair Veyran's damage across the galaxy only for Veyran to discover what he'd done, causing the two to fall out.

title: Taskling
text:
# Taskling

## Biography

Tasklings are creatures who are created to serve a singular purpose for which they will go to any length to fulfill. After they serve their purpose, they expire and vanish into the air. Their motivation to help others comes from the fact that existence is painful to a Taskling, and the only way to be removed from existence is to complete the task they were called to perform. The first Tasklings spawned attributed this invulnerability to their being unable to die until their purpose is fulfilled; whether this means it is physically impossible to kill a Taskling is unclear. In Edge of Talendor: Veyran Die Veyranfall, however, it's shown that Tasklings can die of suffocation when exposed to the vacuum of space.

They typically live for no more than a few hours, and thus two days is an eternity for Tasklings. The longer the Tasklings stay alive, the more sanity they begin to lose. Veyran warns the Voss household to keep their tasks simple.

title: Taskling
text:
If a Taskling is not given a purpose at the beginning of its existence, it seems to default to taking the purpose of the Tasklings before it. This was seen when a Taskling created for Daren created a second Tasklings, which it then to kill a third Tasklings that it was in an argument with. The Tasklings then wildly began pressing the box without giving orders and all the resulting Tasklings began trying in vain to kill the rest of the Tasklings. Additionally, a Taskling can be persuaded to shift their purpose, as seen when the Tasklings who were purposed to either help Daren or kill the other Tasklings were convinced by one to find and kill Daren.

## Appearance

title: Taskling
text:
## Appearance

Taskling is a tall, powder-blue humanoid figure with elongated, narrow limbs. He has a large, bulbous head, beady black eyes, and a giant mouth that stretches across his face. He has a very high-pitched and strident voice, sometimes intoning in screeches. Some versions of him have one or more small patches of orange hair on their head. After being alive for more than several days, Taskling' skin will begin to develop discolored lesions accompanied by random tufts of dark quill-like hairs. Taskling' blood is pure white.

The Oni Exclusive cover of Koseko Tevako shows the inside of a Taskling.

## Personality

title: Taskling
text:
The Oni Exclusive cover of Koseko Tevako shows the inside of a Taskling.

## Personality

Taskling exhibits a friendly, cheerful, and helpful demeanor; willing to assist the one who brought him into existence, however possible. Ideally, Taskling will dispatch the simple task given to him, and disappear shortly after its completion. However, if given a task that is outside of Taskling' capabilities, he will not be able to cease existing. This unusual lifespan will cause Taskling' attitude and mental state to worsen dramatically; the relatively long and tortuous existence quickly drives him to violent behavior and outright insanity. Tasklings who have been spawned in tandem are seen to distrust and attack one another as their sanity decays, although they will continue to attempt any possible solution to their original purpose, including collaboration with other Tasklings. The psychological and physical effects of existence upon Tasklings (e.g. discoloration of skin, hair growth) can manifest in less than 24 hours. According to Daren Voss original Taskling, two days is "an eternity" in Tasklings time.

title: The Confluence
text:
# The Confluence

## Overview

The Confluence is a hivemind and Veyran Kest's former lover. They take the forms of multiple races, sexes, and species, and use both male and female avatars around Veyran.

## Biography

After Veyran, Talen and Neris follow a distress signal coming from a seemingly 'abandoned' ship, a group of Lusazu Rilolo ask for Veyran's help to defeat the evil entity that's taking over their minds. Using the assimilated members of the crew, The Confluence takes control of the group's minds, and they recognize Veyran. Veyran introduces them to his grandchildren, and explains that he and The Confluence used to date.

The four of them return to Nonete Raride. The Confluence speaks with Veyran through its alien citizens, occasionally switching between avatars mid-conversation. They tell Veyran their plans to manage an organization efficient enough to merge with the Vhalan Compact, where they will have access to countless other worlds for them to assimilate until they become "what the single-minded once called a god". Veyran is impressed by this, and the two quickly resume their relationship as lovers.

title: The Confluence
text:
While Veyran and The Confluence rekindle their relationship, The Confluence also takes care of Neris and Talen. The Confluence has so much fun reconnecting with Veyran and performing crazy stunts to impress him (especially making and ingesting Spiral Ash, a powerful drug) that they gradually lose control of their citizens.

After regaining their free will, the citizens of the planet start a race war, chasing after Talen and Neris until a The Confluence-led SWAT team rescues them. Neris and Talen, traumatized, insist that Veyran takes them all home. When Veyran opens a portal for them and insists on staying behind, Neris explains that Veyran has an unhealthy impact on The Confluence, and expresses her disapproval toward their relationship.

Veyran stays with The Confluence for a while longer, but after leaving to use the bathroom, emerges to find that The Confluence has deserted the city (and possibly the planet) and written breakup letters across every surface. They confess their love for Veyran, but ultimately concedes that they cannot be together. Veyran returns home and attempts suicide, but narrowly fails.

As shown from "Midevi Mivide", The Confluence still cares a lot for Veyran despite how they ended their relationship and tried to check up on him multiple times via call and later went to Velora when they heard that he had begun to hunt for "him" once again. When Veyran continually ignores them, they resort to the extreme by taking over the entire state of Zerath.

title: The Confluence
text:
After Loloko Sazusa and Dr. Ivara investigate Zerath after hearing reports of a cult there, Veyran claims that he and The Confluence agreed that the latter would not take over Velora. Veyran and Loloko Sazusa secure the state using a dome and The Confluence approaches Velora in their space vessel to speak to them via video chat. The Confluence and Veyran get into an argument as The Confluence leaves despite their hivemind not properly released. After Loloko Sazusa takes over the hivemind, Veyran and Dr. Ivara meet The Confluence in their space vessel in order to get their help as Veyran and The Confluence get into another argument. Dr. Ivara sides with The Confluence as Veyran ignored their voicemails and tells them that Veyran is changing slowly in which The Confluence agrees to help them by reconnecting them. At the end, The Confluence releases everyone from their hivemind on Velora but does not trust Veyran anymore as Veyran leaves their space vessel due to ruining his chance to reconcile with them.

## Abilities

title: The Confluence
text:
## Abilities

The Confluence assimilates others into the hivemind by using one of its hosts to vomit into another individual's mouth. The Confluence's hosts have been seen acting animalistic while spreading (screeching and pointing at unassimilated individuals), although The Confluence can imitate natural 'humanoid' behavior as well while in a passive, controlled state. It has individual control of everybody it assimilates. While many of The Confluence's hosts are shown to possess yellow sclerae, it has shown to be able to hide it to pose as single-minded.

All of The Confluence's avatars seem to possess the same brain while controlled by it, and The Confluence is able to move and speak transitionally through multiple planet-scale civilizations of people. However, Veyran's blue serum seems to remove its control, leaving The Confluence able to direct less and less bodies at once and making them dizzy.

title: Velvet Expanse
text:
# Velvet Expanse

## Overview

Velvet Expanse is an artificially generated world created by Veyran Kest from a collapsed quantum tesseract some time in the 1980s for his daughter, Selra Voss, when she was a little girl. It appears in "Rakolu Lunone".

Veyran outright admits that his reason for creating Velvet Expanse was to sequester Selra, who clearly showed strong psychotic tendencies as a child, and protect their neighborhood (though he immediately makes it clear that he didn't do so out of the non-existent goodness of his heart, but just so he wouldn't have to clean up any of Selra's messes). Veyran mentioned that all other Veyrans also made a Velvet Expanse for their Selras.

## Description

Velvet Expanse is accessed by drawing an entranceway with what appears to be a glowing purple piece of chalk.

title: Velvet Expanse
text:
## Description

Velvet Expanse is accessed by drawing an entranceway with what appears to be a glowing purple piece of chalk.

The inside of Velvet Expanse consists of a massive area that includes mountains, forests, swamps, and likely other biomes. The weather is always perfectly sunny and warm with procedurally generated clouds rolling across the sky. A rainbow river with a stunning waterfall cuts through the land. The ecosystems are largely fantasy inspired as there are literal swamps of honey. Veyran comments that the native wildlife has imaginary, procedurally-generated carbon DNA.

Velvet Expanse was designed by Veyran to be an incredibly safe place for Selra to play in. All ground surfaces are bouncy to prevent injuries from falling, the rainbow river's water is breathable to prevent drowning, and all velvet creatures were designed to be harmless. However, after Mirano got trapped in Velvet Expanse and started mating with the velvet creatures, the Averan DNA gummed up their bio-carbons, mutating them, causing them to develop aggressiveness and predatory attributes.

title: Verdara
text:
# Verdara

## Biography

In present day, Verdara catches Talen's attention when she stops an evil rat alien named Lunode Mitete. Talen promptly asks her on a date, to which she accepts. After a fire, Talen confesses how he likes her and she is flattered before introducing him to her "children", who treat her like an item. She soon has an interview with the media until becoming surprised when Talen states they are a couple.

However, the Verdant Circle are annoyed by the relationship and want to get rid of Talen for Verdara to focus on making them profits. This causes Talen to go on a murder spree of the Verdant Circle and their potential customers until he obtains their rings. Now free, she and Talen want to be together but his mother forbids it, causing Talen to leave home.

title: Verdara
text: While trying to save the Velora with Talen, without the Verdant Circle to reign her in, Verdara's behavior starts to become increasingly violent starting with slashing the tires on a highway full of cars and then, burning down a congressman's home with a petrol bomb which begins to horrify Talen. Afterwards, at a mining facility, the two confront a group of miners who are about to go underground while Verdara is telling them what their actions are doing to the planet, but they refuse to listen and proceed underground to resume their mining. Although Talen says they'll get them next time, Verdara flies into a fit of rage and burns the entire mining facility to the ground resulting in the deaths of 300 people while Talen watches in tears. These actions cause Talen to decide to tearfully end their relationship amid Verdara's attempts to justify her actions at the mine from his bedroom window. She also brings up how he killed the Verdant Circle, while he states he killed them because they were just going to sell her away and only wanted her free. Verdara then confesses her love for him but he sadly rejects her declaration. Distraught at the rejection, she tearfully curses Talen out before flying away into the night heartbroken, leaving Selra to comfort her heartbroken son.

title: Verdara
text:
## Apocrypha

While she isn't seen again, Veyran manages to activate a device that sends all the villains to different universes with no way out, indicating that Verdara was also sent to a different universe.

## Appearance

Verdara is a humanoid Elemental construct resembling a teenage girl. She has very pale blue skin, turquoise hair and dark blue lips. She is always seen wearing her superhero-esque suit, which is primarily light blue with accents of yellow and includes the recycling symbol, in the shape of a heart, situated on her chest.

When Verdara becomes enraged, she becomes ignited in red flames and her skin and hair shift into a greenish tint. She also gains dark circles around her eyes and her hair begins floating upwards.

## Personality

She instantly formed a bond with Talen and even became infatuated with him very quickly. Verdara also enjoyed her role as a superhero and was joyous whenever she completed a job. Although Verdara was quite happy with her life, she was put under pressure by the Verdant Circle to avoid eating too many calories and disliked being unsummoned by their elemental rings as it took away her autonomy.

title: Verdara
text:
However, as Talen got to know Verdara more, a fanatical side to her activism was revealed. She began engaging in acts of eco-terrorism, such as vandalising cars and bombing the homes of congressmen, and did so with just as much glee as she would with an act of heroism. This came to a head when she attempted to convince miners to stop working and after they refused, she murdered all of them in a fit of rage. Despite Talen being repulsed by this, Verdara remained headstrong in her beliefs and asserted that the miners deserved to die because of the impact they were having on the Velora's climate crisis. Despite insisting she loved Talen and killed the miners to save him and the Velora, their relationship comes to an end and Verdara leaves after telling Talen "Fuck you".

## Powers and Abilities

Elemental control: Verdara is a construct of the elements and thusly has full control over fire, water, dirt and air. She uses these to save the Velora from ecological disasters.

title: Vex Talen
text:
# Vex Talen

## Overview

He is one of the many versions of Talen from across the Ridete Desevi, but unique in being notably amoral, ruthless and displaying intelligence rivalling that of Veyran. He initially appeared alongside Minovi Sadezu, who was hunting down and killing several Veyrans throughout the Ridete Desevi. It was later revealed Minovi Sadezu was merely being controlled by Vex Talen, although he remained undetected and travelled to Concord Spire by posing as one of the Talens liberated from Minovi Sadezu's lair.

He served as the first Talen to be democratically elected President of Concord Spire, and had consolidated his power in a coup by eliminating any disagreeable Veyrans in the Sarisa Rinene. He later used this rise to power to fabricate an escape from the Bounded Horizon, destroying almost the entire Concord Spire and killing countless Veyrans and Talens in the process. Despite his hope to be rid of Veyran once and for all, he finds himself dragged into Veyran Kest N-482 and Talen Voss's circle of influence, reluctantly cooperating with them as they face off against the bigger existential threat of Veyran Oris and the Virazu Lotelo.

title: Vex Talen
text:
Vex Talen assisted Veyran Kest N-482 in taking down Veyran Oris, and stole the plans for the Virazu Lotelo in the process. title: Vex Talen
text:
