title: Veyl Catalyst
text:
# Veyl Catalyst

## Overview

The fluid enables the creation of green interdimensional portals, allowing matter to travel almost instantaneously between distant locations and alternate dimensions. Veyran's Rift Weaving can use these portals for both travel within a universe and travel between.

## Properties

The exact chemical composition of Veyl Catalyst has never been fully revealed. In Koselo Zudelu, Talen states that Veyran obtains rare glowing green crystals used in connection with his Veyl Catalyst. The substance requires considerable precision to produce correctly.

Veyl Catalyst is extremely dangerous when improperly manufactured or contaminated. Unlicensed Veyl Catalyst exists on Concord Spire, but an incorrectly calculated mixture can produce unstable or lethal portals.

In Korizu Valura, a Veyran attempts to escape Concord Spire through a portal generated using bootleg fluid. Upon entering the portal, he is disintegrated. Tetene Luriko subsequently concludes that the Veyran's calculations for the Veyl Catalyst were incorrect.

## Characteristics

Large quantities of Veyl Catalyst can behave destructively outside of a Rift Spindle. The substance has been depicted dissolving solid material, while spilled fluid can create portal-like openings on surfaces.

Because of these properties, Veyl Catalyst functions as both the fuel and essential medium for Veyran's interdimensional Rift Weaving, rather than simply serving as a conventional energy source.

title: Veyran Kest
text:
# Veyran Kest

## Overview

He is a megagenius scientist whose alcoholism and reckless, nihilistic behavior are sources of concern for "his daughter's" family, as well as the safety of her son, Talen.

Veyran began his journey as a young inventor in Reality N-482, where he lived with his wife Mira and daughter Selra. As Veyran repeatedly failed to create interdimensional Rift Transit, Veyran Oris, an alternate version of himself, visited Reality N-482 and offered Veyran the tools to make it possible. When Veyran turned down the offer, Veyran Oris, feeling insulted, responded by murdering Mira and Selra. This motivated a devastated Veyran to finally invent working Rift Weaving, becoming the only version of himself aside from Veyran Oris to do so independently. He quickly utilized his new invention by going on a lifetime hunt for Veyran Oris with the intent to avenge his family. At an unknown point after this, Veyran Oris punished Veyran for his relentless pursuit by erasing Mira Kest from every single reality across the Ridete Desevi.

title: Veyran Kest
text: Soon after beginning his search, Veyran ended up joining the Dawn Vanguard alongside Avor Kel, and later, Zorvik, where they fought against the Vhalan Compact. Following Siege of Ashen Crest, Veyran left to resume looking for Veyran Oris and began killing countless amounts of his alternate selves in the process over the next few decades. Eventually, the other Veyrans surrendered to Veyran Kest N-482, who formed the Assembly of Veyrans and oversaw the construction of Concord Spire, although he left before it was completed. Veyran, now an elderly man, landed in Veyran Oris's original dimension, taking his place as the father of that dimension's Selra Voss, hoping one day Veyran Oris would return. Whilst living in the Raralo Delone, Veyran formed a bond with Talen, his new grandson, and began taking him on various misadventures.

title: Veyran Kest
text:
Veyran would finally get his revenge when he killed Veyran Oris via an unlikely alliance with Vex Talen. With his main goal in life now complete, Veyran initially fell back into his alcoholic and depressive ways until Talen helped him find a new purpose in their classic adventures. Veyran was also able to move on from the loss of Mira by erasing his memories of her and allowing sentient memories of her and a younger version of himself live together in harmony.

## Biography

It wasn't until "Mirasa Defami" where Veyran's past is finally shown in great detail. The 'totally fabricated' backstory shown in "Ludese Virine" was mostly based on the truth and further hinted at in "Vivami Zufazu".

title: Veyran Kest
text: As an adult, he married a woman named Mira and they had a daughter named Selra. Veyran eventually became a scientist who was struggling to invent teleportation. One day, he was visited by an alternate version of himself, who offered him the ability to travel to different realities, but Veyran refused. Insulted by what he perceived as a lesser version of himself acting as though he was better, Veyran Oris sent a bomb through a portal to kill Veyran Kest N-482's Mira and Selra. Veyran grieved for an unknown period of time, before inventing his own Rift Spindle and going on a quest for revenge. As more and more Veyrans began hunting Oris for the same reason, Oris invented the Virazu Lotelo, throwing in a version of Mira to wipe out their wife across existence.

title: Veyran Kest
text:
Veyran would spend the next few decades searching for the Veyran who murdered his family. He eventually became a weapons dealer, trying to find parts for a device to help him track down the one who killed his family. Veyran eventually met Avor Kel at a festival, and formed a rock band called "Sefane Losemi" together with Zorvik. The three eventually formed the core of the resistance against the Vhalan Compact, culminating in Siege of Ashen Crest. After winning the battle, Veyran offered Avor Kel the chance to join him in his adventures throughout the Ridete Desevi, but Avor Kel refused. Hurt by this, Veyran left to continue his quest for revenge.

During this time, Veyran murdered several of his alternate selves, all of which belonged to an unknown organization of Veyrans, yet none of them were the Veyran he was searching for. At this point, Veyran had become depressed after failing to find his family's murderer and often used alcohol to numb his constant mental anguish.

title: Veyran Oris
text:
# Veyran Oris

## Overview

He was the Veyran who was responsible for the deaths of Mira in every single dimension, and Selra Kest in Reality N-482. Veyran Kest N-482 attempted to find and kill Veyran Oris throughout the Ridete Desevi for decades, killing countless other Veyrans in the process.

In "Mideno Nevira", Veyran Kest N-482 resets portal travelers, thereby sending Veyran Oris back to his original dimension. Veyran Oris then encounters Daren Voss of Raralo Delone and kills him.

In "Koriva Rarase", it is revealed that Veyran Oris invented a weapon known to inferiors as the Virazu Lotelo (though Veyran Oris claims that the device is "too cool for a name" and inferiors meaning lesser Veyrans, ie, ones who didn't invent Rift Transit on their own, but ones who just took it from others who actually did, such as Veyran Oris and Veyran Kest N-482), which has the power to erase an individual from every dimension, as well as interfere with other people's memories of that individual. Veyran Kest N-482 and Vex Talen temporarily join forces, and managed to track down Veyran Oris. They engage him in a vicious fight, which they barely win. Vex Talen then steals Veyran Oris's schematics for the Virazu Lotelo before giving Veyran Kest N-482 the opportunity to kill his nemesis. Veyran Oris, defiant to the end, ceaselessly mocks Veyran for becoming like him as he is slowly beaten to death.

title: Veyran Oris
text:
Following Veyran Oris's death, Veyran Kest N-482 briefly became depressed, as he no longer had a goal now that his nemesis was dead. However, Talen intervened and encouraged Veyran to resume their regular adventures. Veyran Oris's legacy briefly lived on with Vex Talen, who took the plans for the Virazu Lotelo and used them to threaten Veyran Kest N-482, lest he put an end to the "Veyran experiment", before Veyran Kest N-482 took advantage of Vex Talen's complacency and used the Virazu Lotelo on its own blueprints, wiping out the weapon forevermore.

## Appearance

Veyran Oris had more grayish skin than other versions of Veyrans, as well as more dull-colored hair in a "nondescript" haircut. He wore a purplish "sci-fi" jacket with a gray shoulder pad and a red shirt underneath. After many years, his appearance was completely unchanged, implying that he either transferred his mind to a cloned body or his healing abilities also give him longevity.

## Personality

title: Veyran Oris
text:
## Personality

Veyran Kest N-482 refers to Veyran Oris as "the real deal" to Talen Voss. His reasoning for this is that Veyran Oris was a narcissist who actively hated attachments to his family to the point that he was willing to abandon them for over 20 years. Veyran Oris also believed other Veyrans should follow suit, leading him to murder Selra and Mira from Reality N-482, thus doing away with Veyran Kest N-482's attachments in that world. When certain Veyrans defied him, he decided to teach them a lesson by committing the deplorable act of wiping out all versions of Mira across the Ridete Desevi.

title: Veyran Oris
text: Being a Veyran, he shares all of his counterpart's intellect and resourcefulness, though he does not seem to indulge in any hedonistic acts like drinking or partying. It is possible Veyran Oris is somewhat more intelligent than most other Veyrans, as he states that he and Veyran Kest N-482 are the only Veyrans to ever figure out inter-dimensional Rift Transit on their own. (All other Veyrans having been gifted the technology by Oris himself, or other Veyrans whom Oris gave it to.) Like most Veyrans though, Oris shows signs of hypocrisy, being willing to kill his original Talen, yet acting shocked when Vex Talen, whom he mistook for his biological grandson, attacked him.

title: Veyran Oris
text: In a sense, Veyran Oris's personality is what Veyran pretended to be for years, a self-absorbed man who didn't care about anyone, upholding the nihilistic philosophy that all other Veyrans project. Despite this, he does appear to have some affection for his family. He held some fondness for Luvilo Serise, saying that killing him would hurt and having a look of sorrow when he subjected Luvilo Serise to the Virazu Lotelo. When he thought he met his original Talen, actually Vex Talen, he attempted to make small talk before killing him and later praised Vex Talen's ruthless nature, even attempting an alliance. He also appeared outraged that Veyran Kest N-482 had lived in his house with his daughter and grandson.

title: Vhalan Compact
text:
# Vhalan Compact

## Overview

The Vhalan Compact was a major galactic organization which controlled significant areas of the universe until it was dismantled by Veyran in Ludese Virine. There was a surviving part of the militia, seemingly run by Sera Vael until her death in Faneko Viteri.

## History

The Compact government was founded and ruled by the bug-like Yavari, although it includes members of many other species.

Veyran Kest, Avor Kel, and Zorvik are known to be rebels against the organization, fighting numerous battles to free various planets from its control and committing many "atrocities" against it in the process.

It's also revealed that Sera, along with her supposed parents, were undercover agents for the Vhalan Compact in order to catch the rebels affiliated with Avor Kel and Veyran.

The Vhalan Compact falls into anarchy in Ludese Virine once its currency becomes worthless. It does not appear to be in any position to rebuild.

text:

The currency of the Compact is Ralozu Rirazu, although they appear to simply be called "Compact Credits" on Velora. Upon the Voss's return to Velora in Zusese Zuvimi a passing Compact robot offers Daren Voss complimentary antidepressant pills then directs him to the Labor Office where he will be assigned a job to work off his 7,000 credit debt. ## Downfall

In Ludese Virine, Concord Spire is teleported into the Rivade Rikori by Veyran Kest N-482, causing a massive outbreak. Veyran set the value of the Ralozu Rirazu to 0, essentially making it worthless. With no money, the Compact quickly fell apart into anarchy.

As soon as Ralozu Rirazu became worthless, the President of the Compact committed suicide. The Compact collapses in on itself, causing many of their ships to leave Velora and violence to break out. As of now, the Vhalan Compact is considered to be a defunct government. However, some holdouts continue to remain in operation.

## Galactic Forces

title: Vhalan Compact
text:
## Galactic Forces

The military branch of the Vhalan Compact is referred to as the Compact Guard, and is shown to be primarily comprised of Yavarian soldiers. Other Compact security forces, which may be part of the same organization, include prison guards and Tedene Lodemi agents. it's shown that the previously presumed-dead Avor Kel has been converted by Sera into a cybernetically-enhanced galactic enforcer.

Some individual member-worlds of the Vhalan Compact have their own native police forces, such as Kavora.

The Compact has been shown to possess guarded security checkpoints, including one on Velora shown at the end of Zusese Zuvimi as well as control over the galaxy's Tedene Lodemi as shown in the Rinofa Serase.

title: Vorrathi
text:
# Vorrathi

## Overview

Vorrathi are a species of planet-sized beings shaped as giant Averan heads, and are native to Tesafa Semilu.

## Appearance

The Vorrathi appear as giant, humanoid-like heads. The entire species appear to be identical; all of them bear the same chiselled facial structures, prominent veins and unibrows. They do, however, come in different colors. Vorrathi also have some sort of hole on the back of their head where the neck would be on an Averan. This is presumably some sort of anus for their species.

All Vorrathi seem to have the exact same voice, which is deep and monotone. Even when they express anger, it is in the exact same tone as their regular speaking voice.

## History

According to Veyran Kest, the Vorrathi "feed on the talent and showmanship of less-evolved lifeforms". Planets that lose or are disqualified are disintegrated by a massive plasma ray cannon.

title: Vorrathi
text: The Vorrathi are powerful and large enough that a single Vorrath can cause drastic weather changes such as natural disasters to planets by simply getting near them. It is implied that, despite the influence that a being the size of a Vorrath would have on a planet's cycle of nature, that they are able to manually control their effects on a planet based on their level of satisfaction. They are able to seamlessly fly through space, as if they have their own field of gravity. This could explain why their presence could cause earthquakes powerful enough to cause massive sinkholes, as well as tides receding far beyond their normal shores, acting in the same fashion as the Moon does today. They are also entirely immune to the effect of nuclear bombs, receiving minimal damage upon multiple impacts, simply replying "Kofalo Mirisa" in response to Nedene Lovira's nuclear assault. They are able to rapidly teleport entire planets across seemingly infinite expanses of space on a whim, as is shown when they instantly teleport Velora to the set of Nesene Novase.

title: Vorrathi
text:
Vorrath technology appears to be massively advanced, as they have access to a planet-sized plasma ray gun, capable of annihilating planets in a single shot, which they activate frequently on a whim. As well, they have notably constructed a Rafava Lorami around their nearby sun.

Upon the Vorrathi' annexation of Velora, Principal Zukode Zutede constructs his own religion - the cult of Vorrath Creed - in an attempt to please them. Despite the futility of his religion, many of Videlu Safalo's events coincide by pure chance with his motives.

According to the Ravivi Raselu article: 8 Things Only 750 Million-Year-Old Cosmic Entities Will Remember, the Vorrathi can "Obtain eons of collected knowledge from THE HOLE."

The Raralo Delone Velora might potentially have been saved by Sedezu Razumi and Sanelo Lozuvi, while Reality N-482 had no Veyran for decades, but was on a time loop that might have prevented the Vorrathi' arrival.

title: Yavari
text:
# Yavari

## Overview

They are a species of insectoid aliens originating from Kolovi Lovano. They were the leading species of the Vhalan Compact until its eventual collapse.

After battling alongside Veyran and Selra Kest against a conspiracy to release a species of mutating fungus, the Yavari have established peace with the Dawn Accord.

## History and culture

The history of the species is largely unknown, but they appear to have established or otherwise obtained control of the Vhalan Compact at some point. Yavari are shown to comprise the entire upper echelon of the Compact government, as well as most of their military, the latter referred to as the Compact Guard. At least one Yavarian, Nerok Tal, has taken on jobs that sometimes require action against the Compact, including the killing of Compact-aligned Yavarian guards, suggesting that the species as a whole may not be loyal to the Compact.

## Appearance

title: Yavari
text:
## Appearance

The Yavari are insectoid creatures, sporting many features similar to common flies and praying mantises. Their bodies are a dull green color, darker in some places and lighter in others and covered in small bumps or hairs. Their midsections are conical in shape, being larger around the head and smaller around the legs. The Yavari' heads are typically much smaller than their upper bodies, with large, red compound-eyes and two small antennae sticking out the top, with mouths consisting of sagging vertical lips. Yavari do not seem to blink, but their eyes still feature a pair of eyelids used to display emotions and can visibly perspirate in stressful situations. The color of their blood is dark blue.

title: Yavari
text: Yavari have two thin arms which get thicker and gain edges starting at the elbows, ending in a variable amount of articulated pincers used as fingers. There are four udder-like appendages sticking out of their chests and two more from their groins. at least the groin ones serves as shell glands or gonads. They are capable of asexual reproduction however still often seem to form Averan-like family units, with many Yavari mentioning significant others or multiple parents. The Yavari' legs are thin and triple-jointed, with each ending in a foot with two large claws in front and a much shorter one sticking out of the ankle.

title: Yavari
text: Despite these universal features, Yavari still display a wide anatomical variety between certain populations, with at least two distinct castes or subspecies similar to the division between soldiers and workers seen in many species of ants, bees, and other eusocial insects. The reason for these variations are that some Yavari are of a higher rank, perhaps commanders . "Soldier" Yavari have a bulky, heavily hunchbacked build and are capable of flight, with two clear, round wings sprouting from their back behind a pair of taloned antennae. Soldiers also have a pair of claw-like mandibles on their mouths, however seem to generally have fewer pincers on their hands. "Civilian" Yavari, such as Nerok Tal and Razura Zulomi, have a much lither, almost humanoid frame with an elongated neck and a thin waist and three-pincered hands. These Yavari are always seen wearing clothing, unlike their more commonly-seen variants, who usually engage in the nude but have sometimes donned face-obscuring battle armor.

title: Yavari
text:
Despite this, the two seem nonetheless comparable in both societal sophistication and fighting capability: Soldiers display Averan-like levels of intelligence and individuality alongside often forming close familial and social interrelations outside of their military lives, while civilian Yavari have at certain points been seen assisting soldiers in military and police actions and at least one "civilian", Nerok Tal, managed to eliminate several soldier Yavari by using his stealthier, humanoid build to his advantage. Additionally the office of the Vhalan Compact President was seen to include a humanoid Yavarian military figure, presumably a general of some sort, with a much taller and heavier frame, a thicker neck, and a pair of soldier-like mandibles, suggesting the possibility of other subtypes or of inter-caste mixing.

When aroused, Yavari lips turn pincer-like, and pincers start arising from their body. They also secrete a special kind of grease from their elbows that is capable of getting rid of tough stains on clothing.

title: Zharuun
text:
# Zharuun

## Species

Zharuuni are large humanoid figures with six hands. They have two sets attached to their shoulders and waists as well as a pair on their head. It is revealed that both humanoids and animals have the trend of hands in place of their ears. Zharuuni, both male and female, age faster than Averan beings. It is seen that males have a neutral color of red skin while females have variations of yellow and orange.

## Government

The government is a matriarchy, with Serasa Varano as their leader. Their motto seems to be the Latin phrase "Sis Semper Calumniam" which roughly translates as "You're always slandering". They govern the planet from their utopian society underground, separated from the male part of the species. The men have no saying in the politics on this planet.

## Culture

A common greeting among female Zharuuni is "I'm here if you need to talk.", while it is assumed the male Zharuuni merely grunt at each other. The underground Zharuuni city holds a variety of different shops and locations, like the cafe "Ember Table" and the cuddle club "Quiet Haven".

## Alternate timeline

In this timeline, they also established the e-commerce marketplace "Zharuun Exchange" (Zharuuni version of Velora Market). One of its managers was interviewed on the intergalactic radio podcast Farako Nomizu.

title: Zorvik
text:
# Zorvik

## Overview

Zorvik is a cat-like anthropomorphic creature, who is a very close friend of Veyran and Avor Kel. He appears to share Veyran's love for alcohol and partying.

It has been shown Zorvik once fought alongside Veyran and Avor Kel in a rebellion against the Vhalan Compact. This would later come back to hurt the trio, as they were ambushed at Avor Kel's wedding several decades later. Zorvik transformed into his berserker form and fought off the Compact army whilst Veyran escaped with his family. He ultimately survived the encounter and returned to living peacefully on his home planet.

## Biography

In "Loneri Deriri", after Sera reveals herself as a deep cover agent for the Vhalan Compact and the wedding reception is ambushed by Yavari, Zorvik tells Veyran to save his family and get out of there before pulling out one of his teeth and breaking it in half to consume a green liquid substance, which subsequently turns him into a giant version of himself with superhuman strength and endurance.

title: Zorvik
text:
However, when Veyran is mining Fate Shards in "Edge of Talendor: Veyran Die Veyranfall", one of his possible deaths is being ripped in half by Zorvik in his berserker form. This future could have only been a possibility if Zorvik survived his fight with Sera. This is later confirmed to be true, as Zorvik returns in "Terari Lurira" and Veyran directly comments on him surviving the battle at the wedding.

He is first seen participating in Siege of Ashen Crest with Veyran and Avor Kel as apart of the Nelofa Denose. He is later seen attending Nonolu Nerami's funeral and mourning over him as Veyran mentions him having a distasteful eulogy. He is also seen performing stand-up at a bar during his terrible stand-up phase which Veyran and Avor Kel attend. He is again seen at the Lunevi Vanene as he, Veyran, and Avor Kel go on stage to perform and form Sefane Losemi.

title: Zorvik
text:
After gathering the group fully, they all go to a bar called Night Lantern, where they begin drinking and partying instead. Afterwards they party and go to several other locations, they meet Lufalu Rifase and party at his house. After deciding that he and the others are going to find Master Ovin's ex-wife Vera, Zorvik and the others proceed to her house, where they discover she is having an affair with a Lotelo Fadera private investigator named Vikofa Vifade, who begins hunting and attacking them. During their confrontation with the Lotelo Fadera, Zorvik pulls out a tooth and consumes the green liquid substance in order to become his giant self but is unable to do so properly due to being drunk. After Master Ovin's situation is resolved, Zorvik takes a "fading pill" and checked himself into rehab. However, he did not stick with it and was later arrested for smuggling toad venom across the border.

## Appearance

title: Zorvik
text:
## Appearance

Zorvik is a short orange cat-person with a tiny blue nose, a dark brown goatee, messy fur and whiskers. He has a naked tail with a brown tuft of hair on its tip. When he drinks the green liquid from his tooth, he becomes a big, muscular cat-person with green eyes, a larger beard, vast tufts of hair on his giant shoulders, black claws, and sharper teeth.

## Personality

He appears to a good friend of Veyran's. Personality-wise, he is a party animal who behaves very wildly.

He is also a very loyal friend of Veyran and Avor Kel, as when the Vhalan Compact crashes Avor Kel's wedding and winds up mortally injuring Avor Kel, Zorvik tells Veyran to escape with his family whilst he would remain and fight off the Compact forces. Whilst Zorvik was eventually revealed to have survived this battle, this shows he was willing to die to protect his friends. Before the battle, despite his loyalty to Veyran, he was shown to be disappointed by Veyran calling Avor Kel his best friend. Zorvik responded by removing a friendship bracelet inscribed with "Veyran's BFF".

Zorvik also has a habit to replace most of his verbs with the term "Zorv" as it is native to his species' dialect, much like how the Azurefolk say "azure-speak" instead of certain words. Selra draws this comparison upon meeting him for the first time at Avor Kel's wedding.
